name.zh: 富冈制丝厂及丝绸工业遗产群
name.en: Tomioka Silk Mill and Related Sites

description.zh: 富冈制丝厂建于1872年，是日本明治政府引进西方技术的第一座大型官营纺织工厂，开创了近代产业化蚕丝生产的先驱。遗产群含四处相关养蚕农场，于2014年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Built in 1872, Tomioka Silk Mill was Japan's first large government-operated Western-style filature, the anchor of the Meiji government's industrialisation drive. The inscribed group includes four sericulture sites. UNESCO-listed in 2014.

zh: 保存完好的19世纪大型法式砖造缫丝工厂
东仓、西仓：巨型砖木混合结构蚕茧仓库
高山社、荒船风穴、田岛弥平旧宅：养蚕技术关联遗址
en: East and West cocoon warehouses: massive brick-and-timber hybrid structures
Associated sericulture sites: Takayama-sha, Arafune Cold Storage, Tajima Yahei Sericulture Farm

duration.zh: 富冈制丝厂约1.5小时，全遗产群一日
duration.en: Tomioka Mill ~1.5 hours; full heritage group 1 day

tips.zh: 从高崎乘上信电铁约40分钟。富冈市内有免费巡回巴士连接各景点。
tips.en: About 40 minutes from Takasaki by Joshin Electric Railway. Free loop buses in Tomioka connect the attractions.
